Chapter 6628: Number One Primal Ancestor

Chapter 6628: Number One Primal Ancestor

An enraged primal ancestor had total authority over sects and kingdoms. Inhabitants would tremble in fear due to their helplessness. Emperors and desolate gods were equally powerless.

What about a supreme overlord? At this realm, the cultivator was a giant among the river of time.

A primal ancestor and heaven-slayer might be affected by the river, eventually reduced to dust. This didn’t apply to an overlord.

In an epoch, the former was a radiant existence while an overlord was the dominant force. The latter could devour the whole epoch in one gulp. However, primal ancestors were limited to just destroying relatively smaller regions, unable to truly consume.

Therefore, no primal ancestors could ever match an overlord regardless of their heaven-defying means. This was akin to a child learning how to walk competing against a muscular athlete.

However, with the help of Mountaincutter, Light God contended against a non-serious overlord, akin to a child blocking an adult’s punch.

Grand Preceptor and his peers observed the exchange and knew they couldn’t have done as well.

“I don’t think it’s ridiculous to give him the number one spot.” The proud Grand Preceptor commented.

If the saber had been used by an immortal, it might have slayed an overlord. An overlord in charge would be able to inflict considerable damage. However, a primal ancestor such as Light God could only slow her down.

“Almighty Three Immortals’ Blessing!” He had no choice but to burn his true blood, causing Heaven World to shake violently as if smashed by a hammer.

His greatest ace card activated and erupted like an inferno.

“Immortals...” Living beings in Three Immortals trembled in fear.

Three figures appeared among the inferno, suppressing everyone. Even Staff Ancestor was affected.

“The three immortals!” Grand Preceptor shouted.

Everyone believed Light God had inherited their legacy upon seeing this. Once empowered, his slash finally forced her hand back.

“Nice!” Others cheered him on.

“Well done.” Dugu Yuan, the lone wolf, became excited with a tinge of red on his cheeks as if he had drunk a fair share of wine.

A primal ancestor had exchanged one move evenly against an overlord without staggering backward. This was nothing short of a miracle. The ant had revealed his fangs and blocked a claw strike from a true dragon without suffering any damage.

“The strongest primal ancestor.” No one had an issue with this classification.

Staff Ancestor was surprised mainly because he didn’t yield a single step. This was unprecedented in her experience.

“The successor of the three immortals, impressive.” She murmured. No other primal ancestor could have done this against her.

“But this is as far as it goes.” Her gaze sharpened and the atmosphere became tense. The world seemed unable to bear her true strength.

“Not good!” Dugu Yuan and the others shouted.
